明白了，你希望把这个“采购管理部物料查询系统”页面整体风格改成类似每日待办页面的风格，保持 TailwindCSS，整体更加现代、清爽、卡片化，按钮更醒目、表格更整齐、视觉层次更清晰。下面我帮你改了一版完整的 HTML：

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>采购管理部物料查询系统</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <style>
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-in; }
    table th { position: sticky; top: 0; background-color: #f87171; }
  </style>
</head>

<body class="bg-gray-50 font-sans text-gray-800">

  <!-- 页头 -->
  <header class="bg-red-600 text-white py-6 shadow flex flex-col items-center">
    <img src="/assets/img/trtlogo.png" alt="LOGO" class="h-16 w-auto mb-2 object-contain">
    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold tracking-wide">生产物料查询系统</h1>
  </header>

  <main class="max-w-7xl mx-auto mt-8 p-6 fade-in">

    <!-- 信息提示 -->
    <div class="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-center rounded-lg p-4 mb-6 text-sm">
      <p class="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
        <span class="font-semibold">⚠️ 保密声明：所有数据均属内部信息，严禁泄露。</span>
        <span>📊 数据来源：采购管理部</span>
        <span>🔍 查询范围：2022年1月1日 - 2025年10月14日</span>
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- 查询区域 -->
    <div class="bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-6 mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
      <select id="year" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400">
        <option value="">全部年份</option>
        <option value="2025">2025</option>
        <option value="2024">2024</option>
        <option value="2023">2023</option>
        <option value="2022">2022</option>
      </select>
      <input id="supplier" type="text" placeholder="供应商名称（可简称）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
      <input id="projectNo" type="text" placeholder="项目号（需精准）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
      <input id="projectName" type="text" placeholder="项目名称（可简称）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
      <button onclick="searchData()" class="bg-red-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 transition shadow">查询</button>
      <button onclick="resetForm()" class="bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 transition shadow">重置</button>
      <button onclick="exportTableToExcel('查询结果.xlsx')" class="bg-green-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-600 transition shadow">导出Excel</button>
    </div>

    <!-- 汇总区 -->
    <div id="summary" class="hidden mb-4 flex gap-4">
      <div class="flex-1 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg p-4 font-semibold text-red-700 text-center shadow">
        匹配结果：<span id="count"></span> 条
      </div>
      <div class="flex-1 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-4 font-semibold text-green-700 text-center shadow">
        金额总计：<span id="total"></span> 元
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 查询结果 -->
    <div id="loading" class="text-center text-red-600 font-medium my-6">⏳ 数据加载中...</div>
    <div id="result" class="fade-in overflow-x-auto bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-4"></div>

  </main>

  <footer class="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mt-8 mb-4">
    © 2025 德令哈采购管理部提供技术和数据支持
  </footer>

  <script>
    let dataCache = [];

    fetch('data.json')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        dataCache = data;
        document.getElementById("loading").style.display = "none";
        console.log("✅ 数据已加载:", dataCache.length, "条");
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error("❌ 数据加载失败:", err);
        document.getElementById("loading").textContent = "❌ 无法加载数据，请检查 data.json 文件路径。";
      });

    function searchData() {
      const year = document.getElementById("year").value.trim();
      const supplier = document.getElementById("supplier").value.trim();
      const projectNo = document.getElementById("projectNo").value.trim();
      const projectName = document.getElementById("projectName").value.trim();

      if (!year && !supplier && !projectNo && !projectName) {
        alert("请输入至少一项查询条件！");
        return;
      }

      let filtered = dataCache.filter(item => {
        const supplierStr = item["供应商名称"] || "";
        const projectNoStr = item["项目号"] || "";
        const projectNameStr = item["项目名称"] || "";
        const contractNoStr = item["合同编号"] || "";

        const matchYear = year ? contractNoStr.includes(year) : true;
        const matchSupplier = supplier ? supplierStr.includes(supplier) : true;
        const matchProjectNo = projectNo ? projectNoStr.includes(projectNo) : true;
        const matchProjectName = projectName ? projectNameStr.includes(projectName) : true;

        return matchYear && matchSupplier && matchProjectNo && matchProjectName;
      });

      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aNum = Number(a["合同编号"].match(/\d+/g)?.join('') || 0);
        const bNum = Number(b["合同编号"].match(/\d+/g)?.join('') || 0);
        return bNum - aNum;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("summary").classList.add("hidden");
        document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "<p class='text-center text-gray-500'>未找到匹配的数据。</p>";
        return;
      }

      let total = filtered.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item["订单总额"] || 0), 0);

      document.getElementById("summary").classList.remove("hidden");
      document.getElementById("count").textContent = filtered.length;
      document.getElementById("total").textContent = total.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2});

      let tableHTML = `
        <table class="w-full text-sm text-center border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm">
          <thead class="bg-red-600 text-white">
            <tr>
              <th class="p-2">项目号</th>
              <th class="p-2">项目名称</th>
              <th class="p-2">数量</th>
              <th class="p-2">单位</th>
              <th class="p-2">采购单价</th>
              <th class="p-2">订单总额</th>
              <th class="p-2">供应商名称</th>
              <th class="p-2">合同编号</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${filtered.map((row, i) => `
              <tr class="${i % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-gray-50' : 'bg-white'} hover:bg-red-50 transition">
                <td class="p-2">${row["项目号"] || ""}</td>
                <td class="p-2">${row["项目名称"] || ""}</td>
                <td class="p-2">${row["数量"] || ""}</td>
                <td class="p-2">${row["单位"] || ""}</td>
                <td class="p-2">${Number(row["采购单价"] || 0).toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td class="p-2">${Number(row["订单总额"] || 0).toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td class="p-2">${row["供应商名称"] || ""}</td>
                <td class="p-2">${row["合同编号"] || ""}</td>
              </tr>
            `).join('')}
          </tbody>
          <tfoot class="bg-gray-100 font-semibold">
            <tr>
              <td colspan="6" class="p-2 text-right">金额总计：</td>
              <td colspan="2" class="p-2 text-red-700">${total.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2})}</td>
            </tr>
          </tfoot>
        </table>
      `;

      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = tableHTML;
    }

    function resetForm() {
      ["year","supplier","projectNo","projectName"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = "");
      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "";
      document.getElementById("summary").classList.add("hidden");
    }

    function exportTableToExcel(filename) {
      const table = document.querySelector("#result table");
      if (!table) { alert("请先执行查询！"); return; }
      const html = table.outerHTML.replace(/ /g, '%20');
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = 'data:application/vnd.ms-excel,' + html;
      link.download = filename;
      link.click();
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

✅改进点总结：

  1. 整体色彩 ：背景淡灰色，卡片白色 + 阴影，和每日待办风格统一。

  2. 查询区域 ：卡片化 + 阴影，按钮圆角 + 过渡效果。

  3. 汇总信息 ：左右卡片式展示数量和总金额，直观醒目。

  4. 表格 ：表头红色，奇偶行灰白交替，鼠标悬停高亮。

  5. 动画 ：fade-in 动画保留，增加页面动感。

  6. 响应式 ：保持 TailwindCSS flex-wrap，使手机端可折行显示。

如果你愿意，我可以再进一步把表格改成“卡片式列表”风格，类似每日待办页面，每条数据就是一个独立的卡片，更美观、可滚动，手机端体验更好。

  • 总金额和数量仍在顶部汇总

    <div class="bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-6 mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">

  <script>
    let dataCache = [];

    fetch('data.json')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        dataCache = data;
        document.getElementById("loading").style.display = "none";
        console.log("✅ 数据已加载:", dataCache.length, "条");
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error("❌ 数据加载失败:", err);
        document.getElementById("loading").textContent = "❌ 无法加载数据，请检查 data.json 文件路径。";
      });

    function searchData() {
      const year = document.getElementById("year").value.trim();
      const supplier = document.getElementById("supplier").value.trim();
      const projectNo = document.getElementById("projectNo").value.trim();
      const projectName = document.getElementById("projectName").value.trim();

      if (!year && !supplier && !projectNo && !projectName) {
        alert("请输入至少一项查询条件！");
        return;
      }

      let filtered = dataCache.filter(item => {
        const supplierStr = item["供应商名称"] || "";
        const projectNoStr = item["项目号"] || "";
        const projectNameStr = item["项目名称"] || "";
        const contractNoStr = item["合同编号"] || "";

        const matchYear = year ? contractNoStr.includes(year) : true;
        const matchSupplier = supplier ? supplierStr.includes(supplier) : true;
        const matchProjectNo = projectNo ? projectNoStr.includes(projectNo) : true;
        const matchProjectName = projectName ? projectNameStr.includes(projectName) : true;

        return matchYear && matchSupplier && matchProjectNo && matchProjectName;
      });

      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aNum = Number(a["合同编号"].match(/\d+/g)?.join('') || 0);
        const bNum = Number(b["合同编号"].match(/\d+/g)?.join('') || 0);
        return bNum - aNum;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("summary").classList.add("hidden");
        document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "<p class='text-center text-gray-500'>未找到匹配的数据。</p>";
        return;
      }

      let total = filtered.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item["订单总额"] || 0), 0);

      document.getElementById("summary").classList.remove("hidden");
      document.getElementById("count").textContent = filtered.length;
      document.getElementById("total").textContent = total.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2});

      let cardsHTML = filtered.map((row, i) => `
        <div class="bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between gap-2 hover:shadow-lg transition">
          <div class="flex-1">
            <p><span class="font-semibold">项目号：</span>${row["项目号"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">项目名称：</span>${row["项目名称"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">供应商：</span>${row["供应商名称"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">合同编号：</span>${row["合同编号"] || ""}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col md:items-end gap-1">
            <p><span class="font-semibold">数量：</span>${row["数量"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">单位：</span>${row["单位"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">采购单价：</span>${Number(row["采购单价"] || 0).toLocaleString()}</p>
            <p class="text-red-600 font-bold"><span class="font-semibold">订单总额：</span>${Number(row["订单总额"] || 0).toLocaleString()}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = cardsHTML;
    }

    function resetForm() {
      ["year","supplier","projectNo","projectName"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = "");
      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "";
      document.getElementById("summary").classList.add("hidden");
    }

    function exportTableToExcel(filename) {
      if (!dataCache.length) { alert("请先执行查询！"); return; }

      let headers = ["项目号","项目名称","数量","单位","采购单价","订单总额","供应商名称","合同编号"];
      let csvContent = headers.join(",") + "\n";

      let filtered = document.querySelectorAll("#result > div");
      filtered.forEach(card => {
        let values = [];
        card.querySelectorAll("p").forEach(p => {
          values.push(p.textContent.split("：")[1] || "");
        });
        csvContent += values.join(",") + "\n";
      });

      const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      link.download = filename;
      link.click();
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

✅改进点：

  1. 每条记录变成独立卡片，左右分栏显示基本信息和数量/金额信息

  2. 手机端自动折行，桌面端左右排版

  3. 卡片悬停增加阴影，视觉更灵动

  4. 导出功能改成 CSV，更适合卡片形式

Q3 · 标题栏左侧logo，右侧标题（第 3 轮对话）

提问： 标题栏左侧logo，右侧标题

明白了，你希望页头改成左侧 LOGO，右侧标题的布局，而不是上下居中排列。我帮你调整成Flex 布局，响应式也兼容手机端：

下面是修改后的页头部分及整体整合的 HTML（只改了 header，其余保持卡片式列表风格）：

<header class="bg-red-600 text-white py-4 shadow">
  <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between px-4">
    <!-- 左侧 LOGO -->
    <img src="/assets/img/trtlogo.png" alt="LOGO" class="h-12 w-auto object-contain">

    <!-- 右侧标题 -->
    <h1 class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tracking-wide">生产物料查询系统</h1>
  </div>
</header>

✅说明：

  • 使用 flex + justify-between ，左 LOGO，右标题

  • 高度和间距适中，手机端也会自动缩放

  • 标题字体大小在桌面端是 2xl，手机端是 xl

  • 保留红色背景和阴影，视觉醒目

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>采购管理部物料查询系统</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <style>
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-in; }
  </style>
</head>

<body class="bg-gray-50 font-sans text-gray-800">

  <!-- 页头：白色背景，左 LOGO 右标题 -->
  <header class="bg-white py-4 shadow">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between px-4">
      <img src="/assets/img/trtlogo.png" alt="LOGO" class="h-12 w-auto object-contain">
      <h1 class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tracking-wide text-gray-900">生产物料查询系统</h1>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="max-w-7xl mx-auto mt-8 p-6 fade-in">

    <!-- 信息提示 -->
    <div class="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-center rounded-lg p-4 mb-6 text-sm">
      <p class="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
        <span class="font-semibold">⚠️ 保密声明：所有数据均属内部信息，严禁泄露。</span>
        <span>📊 数据来源：采购管理部</span>
        <span>🔍 查询范围：2022年1月1日 - 2025年10月14日</span>
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- 查询区域 -->
    <div class="bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-6 mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
      <select id="year" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400">
        <option value="">全部年份</option>
        <option value="2025">2025</option>
        <option value="2024">2024</option>
        <option value="2023">2023</option>
        <option value="2022">2022</option>
      </select>
      <input id="supplier" type="text" placeholder="供应商名称（可简称）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
      <input id="projectNo" type="text" placeholder="项目号（需精准）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
      <input id="projectName" type="text" placeholder="项目名称（可简称）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
      <button onclick="searchData()" class="bg-red-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 transition shadow">查询</button>
      <button onclick="resetForm()" class="bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 transition shadow">重置</button>
      <button onclick="exportTableToExcel('查询结果.xlsx')" class="bg-green-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-600 transition shadow">导出Excel</button>
    </div>

    <!-- 汇总区 -->
    <div id="summary" class="hidden mb-4 flex gap-4">
      <div class="flex-1 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg p-4 font-semibold text-red-700 text-center shadow">
        匹配结果：<span id="count"></span> 条
      </div>
      <div class="flex-1 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-4 font-semibold text-green-700 text-center shadow">
        金额总计：<span id="total"></span> 元
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 查询结果 -->
    <div id="loading" class="text-center text-red-600 font-medium my-6">⏳ 数据加载中...</div>
    <div id="result" class="fade-in flex flex-col gap-4"></div>

  </main>

  <footer class="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mt-8 mb-4">
    © 2025 德令哈采购管理部提供技术和数据支持
  </footer>

  <script>
    let dataCache = [];

    fetch('data.json')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        dataCache = data;
        document.getElementById("loading").style.display = "none";
        console.log("✅ 数据已加载:", dataCache.length, "条");
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error("❌ 数据加载失败:", err);
        document.getElementById("loading").textContent = "❌ 无法加载数据，请检查 data.json 文件路径。";
      });

    function searchData() {
      const year = document.getElementById("year").value.trim();
      const supplier = document.getElementById("supplier").value.trim();
      const projectNo = document.getElementById("projectNo").value.trim();
      const projectName = document.getElementById("projectName").value.trim();

      if (!year && !supplier && !projectNo && !projectName) {
        alert("请输入至少一项查询条件！");
        return;
      }

      let filtered = dataCache.filter(item => {
        const supplierStr = item["供应商名称"] || "";
        const projectNoStr = item["项目号"] || "";
        const projectNameStr = item["项目名称"] || "";
        const contractNoStr = item["合同编号"] || "";

        const matchYear = year ? contractNoStr.includes(year) : true;
        const matchSupplier = supplier ? supplierStr.includes(supplier) : true;
        const matchProjectNo = projectNo ? projectNoStr.includes(projectNo) : true;
        const matchProjectName = projectName ? projectNameStr.includes(projectName) : true;

        return matchYear && matchSupplier && matchProjectNo && matchProjectName;
      });

      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aNum = Number(a["合同编号"].match(/\d+/g)?.join('') || 0);
        const bNum = Number(b["合同编号"].match(/\d+/g)?.join('') || 0);
        return bNum - aNum;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("summary").classList.add("hidden");
        document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "<p class='text-center text-gray-500'>未找到匹配的数据。</p>";
        return;
      }

      let total = filtered.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item["订单总额"] || 0), 0);

      document.getElementById("summary").classList.remove("hidden");
      document.getElementById("count").textContent = filtered.length;
      document.getElementById("total").textContent = total.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2});

      let cardsHTML = filtered.map((row, i) => `
        <div class="bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between gap-2 hover:shadow-lg transition">
          <div class="flex-1">
            <p><span class="font-semibold">项目号：</span>${row["项目号"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">项目名称：</span>${row["项目名称"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">供应商：</span>${row["供应商名称"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">合同编号：</span>${row["合同编号"] || ""}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col md:items-end gap-1">
            <p><span class="font-semibold">数量：</span>${row["数量"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">单位：</span>${row["单位"] || ""}</p>
            <p><span class="font-semibold">采购单价：</span>${Number(row["采购单价"] || 0).toLocaleString()}</p>
            <p class="text-red-600 font-bold"><span class="font-semibold">订单总额：</span>${Number(row["订单总额"] || 0).toLocaleString()}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = cardsHTML;
    }

    function resetForm() {
      ["year","supplier","projectNo","projectName"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = "");
      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "";
      document.getElementById("summary").classList.add("hidden");
    }

    function exportTableToExcel(filename) {
      if (!dataCache.length) { alert("请先执行查询！"); return; }

      let headers = ["项目号","项目名称","数量","单位","采购单价","订单总额","供应商名称","合同编号"];
      let csvContent = headers.join(",") + "\n";

      let filtered = document.querySelectorAll("#result > div");
      filtered.forEach(card => {
        let values = [];
        card.querySelectorAll("p").forEach(p => {
          values.push(p.textContent.split("：")[1] || "");
        });
        csvContent += values.join(",") + "\n";
      });

      const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      link.download = filename;
      link.click();
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

Q8 · 查询后的结果不要采用卡片形式，（第 8 轮对话）

提问： 查询后的结果不要采用卡片形式，

明白了，你希望查询后的结果恢复表格形式，而不是卡片形式，同时保留标题栏卡片化和查询区域卡片化的风格。这样查询结果更直观、易比对。

我帮你修改 HTML 和 JS，整合后的完整版本如下：

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>采购管理部物料查询系统</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <style>
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-in; }
    table th { position: sticky; top: 0; background-color: white; z-index: 10; }
  </style>
</head>

<body class="bg-gray-50 font-sans text-gray-800">

  <!-- 卡片式标题栏：LOGO + 标题 + 保密声明 -->
  <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-4 mb-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 fade-in">
    <!-- 左侧：LOGO + 系统标题 -->
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
      <img src="/assets/img/trtlogo.png" alt="LOGO" class="h-12 w-auto object-contain">
      <h1 class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">生产物料查询系统</h1>
    </div>

    <!-- 右侧：保密声明等信息 -->
    <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row flex-wrap gap-2 text-gray-700 text-sm md:text-base">
      <span class="px-2 py-1 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded font-semibold text-red-600">⚠️ 保密声明：所有数据均属内部信息，严禁泄露</span>
      <span class="px-2 py-1 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded text-green-700">📊 数据来源：采购管理部</span>
      <span class="px-2 py-1 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded text-yellow-700">🔍 查询范围：2022年1月1日 - 2025年10月14日</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 查询区域 -->
  <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-6 mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center fade-in">
    <select id="year" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400">
      <option value="">全部年份</option>
      <option value="2025">2025</option>
      <option value="2024">2024</option>
      <option value="2023">2023</option>
      <option value="2022">2022</option>
    </select>
    <input id="supplier" type="text" placeholder="供应商名称（可简称）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
    <input id="projectNo" type="text" placeholder="项目号（需精准）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
    <input id="projectName" type="text" placeholder="项目名称（可简称）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
    <button onclick="searchData()" class="bg-red-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 transition shadow">查询</button>
    <button onclick="resetForm()" class="bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 transition shadow">重置</button>
    <button onclick="exportTableToExcel('查询结果.xlsx')" class="bg-green-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-600 transition shadow">导出Excel</button>
  </div>

  <!-- 汇总区 -->
  <div id="summary" class="max-w-7xl mx-auto hidden mb-4 flex gap-4 fade-in">
    <div class="flex-1 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg p-4 font-semibold text-red-700 text-center shadow">
      匹配结果：<span id="count"></span> 条
    </div>
    <div class="flex-1 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-4 font-semibold text-green-700 text-center shadow">
      金额总计：<span id="total"></span> 元
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 查询结果 -->
  <div id="loading" class="text-center text-red-600 font-medium my-6 fade-in">⏳ 数据加载中...</div>
  <div id="result" class="max-w-7xl mx-auto overflow-x-auto fade-in"></div>

  <footer class="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mt-8 mb-4">
    © 2025 德令哈采购管理部提供技术和数据支持
  </footer>

  <script>
    let dataCache = [];

    fetch('data.json')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        dataCache = data;
        document.getElementById("loading").style.display = "none";
        console.log("✅ 数据已加载:", dataCache.length, "条");
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error("❌ 数据加载失败:", err);
        document.getElementById("loading").textContent = "❌ 无法加载数据，请检查 data.json 文件路径。";
      });

    function searchData() {
      const year = document.getElementById("year").value.trim();
      const supplier = document.getElementById("supplier").value.trim();
      const projectNo = document.getElementById("projectNo").value.trim();
      const projectName = document.getElementById("projectName").value.trim();

      if (!year && !supplier && !projectNo && !projectName) {
        alert("请输入至少一项查询条件！");
        return;
      }

      let filtered = dataCache.filter(item => {
        const supplierStr = item["供应商名称"] || "";
        const projectNoStr = item["项目号"] || "";
        const projectNameStr = item["项目名称"] || "";
        const contractNoStr = item["合同编号"] || "";

        const matchYear = year ? contractNoStr.includes(year) : true;
        const matchSupplier = supplier ? supplierStr.includes(supplier) : true;
        const matchProjectNo = projectNo ? projectNoStr.includes(projectNo) : true;
        const matchProjectName = projectName ? projectNameStr.includes(projectName) : true;

        return matchYear && matchSupplier && matchProjectNo && matchProjectName;
      });

      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aNum = Number(a["合同编号"].match(/\d+/g)?.join('') || 0);
        const bNum = Number(b["合同编号"].match(/\d+/g)?.join('') || 0);
        return bNum - aNum;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById("summary").classList.add("hidden");
        document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "<p class='text-center text-gray-500'>未找到匹配的数据。</p>";
        return;
      }

      let total = filtered.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item["订单总额"] || 0), 0);

      document.getElementById("summary").classList.remove("hidden");
      document.getElementById("count").textContent = filtered.length;
      document.getElementById("total").textContent = total.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2});

      // 构建表格
      let tableHTML = `
        <table class="w-full text-sm text-center border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm">
          <thead class="bg-gray-100 font-semibold sticky top-0">
            <tr>
              <th class="p-2 border-b">项目号</th>
              <th class="p-2 border-b">项目名称</th>
              <th class="p-2 border-b">数量</th>
              <th class="p-2 border-b">单位</th>
              <th class="p-2 border-b">采购单价</th>
              <th class="p-2 border-b">订单总额</th>
              <th class="p-2 border-b">供应商名称</th>
              <th class="p-2 border-b">合同编号</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${filtered.map((row,i) => `
              <tr class="${i%2===0?'bg-gray-50':'bg-white'} hover:bg-red-50 transition">
                <td class="p-2 border-b">${row["项目号"]||""}</td>
                <td class="p-2 border-b">${row["项目名称"]||""}</td>
                <td class="p-2 border-b">${row["数量"]||""}</td>
                <td class="p-2 border-b">${row["单位"]||""}</td>
                <td class="p-2 border-b">${Number(row["采购单价"]||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td class="p-2 border-b text-red-600 font-semibold">${Number(row["订单总额"]||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td class="p-2 border-b">${row["供应商名称"]||""}</td>
                <td class="p-2 border-b">${row["合同编号"]||""}</td>
              </tr>
            `).join('')}
          </tbody>
          <tfoot class="bg-gray-100 font-semibold">
            <tr>
              <td colspan="5" class="p-2 text-right">金额总计：</td>
              <td colspan="3" class="p-2 text-red-700">${total.toLocaleString(undefined,{minimumFractionDigits:2})}</td>
            </tr>
          </tfoot>
        </table>
      `;

      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = tableHTML;
    }

    function resetForm() {
      ["year","supplier","projectNo","projectName"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = "");
      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "";
      document.getElementById("summary").classList.add("hidden");
    }

    function exportTableToExcel(filename) {
      const table = document.querySelector("#result table");
      if (!table) { alert("请先执行查询！"); return; }
      const html = table.outerHTML.replace(/ /g, '%20');
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = 'data:application/vnd.ms-excel,' + html;
      link.download = filename;
      link.click();
    }
  </script>

</body>
</html>

✅修改点总结：

  1. 查询结果恢复 表格形式 ，每行交替背景色，金额高亮红色

  2. 页头卡片化保留：LOGO + 系统标题 + 保密声明

  3. 查询区域仍为卡片式、圆角、阴影

  4. 响应式表格可横向滚动（ overflow-x-auto ）

明白，你希望把BOM查询系统改成点击查询按钮才搜索，去掉原来的“输入即响应”，并参考每日待办页面和物料查询系统的风格进行美化。下面是修改后的完整版本：

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>产品BOM查询系统</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <style>
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-in; }
    table th { position: sticky; top: 0; background-color: white; z-index: 10; }
    mark { background-color: #fff59d; color: inherit; padding: 0; }

    .parent-header {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fbbfbc, #f87171);
      color: #ffffff;
    }
    .parent-row {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffe4e1, #ffe0e0);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .child-row {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fff8dc, #fffad1);
    }
    tbody tr:hover {
      background-color: #fce4e4;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body class="bg-gray-50 font-sans text-gray-800">

  <!-- 卡片式标题 + 保密声明 -->
  <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-4 mb-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 fade-in">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
      <img src="/assets/img/trtlogo.png" alt="LOGO" class="h-12 w-auto object-contain">
      <h1 class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">产品BOM查询系统</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row flex-wrap gap-2 text-gray-700 text-sm md:text-base">
      <span class="px-2 py-1 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded font-semibold text-red-600">⚠️ 保密声明：所有数据均属内部信息，严禁泄露</span>
      <span class="px-2 py-1 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded text-green-700">📊 数据来源：采购管理部</span>
      <span class="px-2 py-1 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded text-yellow-700">如查询不到，请联系王维添加</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 查询区域 -->
  <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-6 mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center fade-in">
    <input id="nameSearch" type="text" placeholder="品名（模糊搜索）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
    <input id="projectSearch" type="text" placeholder="项目号（精准搜索）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
    <input id="materialIDSearch" type="text" placeholder="物料项目号（精准搜索）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
    <input id="materialNameSearch" type="text" placeholder="物料名称（模糊搜索）" class="border border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-2 flex-1 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400" />
    <button id="searchBtn" class="bg-red-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 transition shadow">查询</button>
    <button id="resetBtn" class="bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 transition shadow">重置</button>
  </div>

  <!-- 查询结果 -->
  <div id="loading" class="text-center text-red-600 font-medium my-6">⏳ 数据加载中...</div>
  <div id="result" class="max-w-7xl mx-auto overflow-x-auto fade-in"></div>

  <footer class="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mt-8 mb-4">© 2025 德令哈采购管理部提供技术和数据支持</footer>

  <script>
    let bomData = [];

    fetch('bom_data.json?_v=' + Date.now())
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        if(!Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error("数据格式错误，必须为数组");
        bomData = data.map(item => ({
          项目号: String(item.项目号 || "").trim(),
          品名: String(item.品名 || "").trim(),
          规格: String(item.规格 || "").trim(),
          零售价: String(item["零售价（元）"] ?? item.零售价 ?? "").trim(),
          物料项目号: String(item.物料项目号 || "").trim(),
          物料名称: String(item.物料名称 || "").trim(),
          数量: String(item.数量 || "").trim(),
          计量单位: String(item.计量单位 || "").trim()
        }));
        document.getElementById("loading").style.display = "none";
        console.log("✅ 数据加载成功", bomData.length, "条");
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error("❌ 数据加载失败:", err);
        document.getElementById("loading").textContent = "❌ 数据加载失败，请检查路径或格式";
      });

    function highlight(text, keyword) {
      if (!keyword) return text || "";
      const reg = new RegExp(`(${keyword.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&')})`, "gi");
      return (text || "").replace(reg, "<mark>$1</mark>");
    }

    function renderFiltered() {
      const nameKeyword = document.getElementById("nameSearch").value.trim();
      const projectID = document.getElementById("projectSearch").value.trim();
      const materialID = document.getElementById("materialIDSearch").value.trim();
      const materialName = document.getElementById("materialNameSearch").value.trim();

      const resultDiv = document.getElementById("result");
      resultDiv.innerHTML = "";

      if (!nameKeyword && !projectID && !materialID && !materialName) {
        alert("请输入至少一项查询条件！");
        return;
      }

      let filtered = bomData.filter(item =>
        (!nameKeyword || item.品名.includes(nameKeyword)) &&
        (!projectID || item.项目号 === projectID)
      );

      if (materialID || materialName) {
        const matchedProjects = new Set(
          bomData
            .filter(item =>
              (!materialID || item.物料项目号 === materialID) &&
              (!materialName || item.物料名称.includes(materialName))
            )
            .map(item => item.项目号)
        );
        filtered = filtered.filter(item => matchedProjects.has(item.项目号));
      }

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        resultDiv.innerHTML = "<p class='text-center text-gray-500'>未找到匹配结果。</p>";
        return;
      }

      const grouped = {};
      filtered.forEach(item => {
        if (!grouped[item.项目号]) grouped[item.项目号] = [];
        grouped[item.项目号].push(item);
      });

      let tableHTML = `
        <table class="w-full text-sm text-center border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm">
          <thead class="parent-header">
            <tr>
              <th class="p-2">项目号</th>
              <th class="p-2">品名</th>
              <th class="p-2">规格</th>
              <th class="p-2">零售价</th>
              <th class="p-2">物料项目号</th>
              <th class="p-2">物料名称</th>
              <th class="p-2">数量</th>
              <th class="p-2">计量单位</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
      `;

      for (const [proj, items] of Object.entries(grouped)) {
        const parent = items[0];
        tableHTML += `
          <tr class="parent-row">
            <td class="border p-2">${highlight(parent.项目号, projectID)}</td>
            <td class="border p-2">${highlight(parent.品名, nameKeyword)}</td>
            <td class="border p-2">${highlight(parent.规格, "")}</td>
            <td class="border p-2">${highlight(parent.零售价, "")}</td>
            <td class="border p-2 text-center" colspan="4">物料明细如下 ↓</td>
          </tr>
        `;
        items.forEach(child => {
          tableHTML += `
            <tr class="child-row">
              <td class="border p-2"></td>
              <td class="border p-2"></td>
              <td class="border p-2"></td>
              <td class="border p-2"></td>
              <td class="border p-2">${highlight(child.物料项目号, materialID)}</td>
              <td class="border p-2">${highlight(child.物料名称, materialName)}</td>
              <td class="border p-2">${highlight(child.数量, "")}</td>
              <td class="border p-2">${highlight(child.计量单位, "")}</td>
            </tr>
          `;
        });
      }

      tableHTML += `</tbody></table>`;
      resultDiv.innerHTML = tableHTML;
    }

    document.getElementById("searchBtn").addEventListener("click", renderFiltered);
    document.getElementById("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      ["nameSearch","projectSearch","materialIDSearch","materialNameSearch"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = "");
      document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = "";
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

✅修改点：

  1. 去掉“输入即响应” ，增加 查询 按钮才触发搜索

  • 左侧悬浮/可收起导航

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>产品系列展示</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <style>
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-in; }
    #sidebar { transition: transform 0.3s; z-index:50; }
    #sidebar.hidden { transform: translateX(-100%); }
    #sidebar.show { transform: translateX(0); }
    #toggleBtn { position: fixed; top: 1rem; left: 1rem; z-index:60; background-color:#ef4444; }
    .product-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.03); box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
    #lightbox { display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.8); justify-content:center; align-items:center; z-index:100; }
    #lightbox img { max-width:90%; max-height:90%; border-radius:8px; }
    .max-h-card { max-height:380px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-50 font-sans">

  <!-- 顶部卡片 -->
  <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto bg-white shadow rounded-xl p-4 mb-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 fade-in">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
      <img src="/assets/img/trtlogo.png" alt="LOGO" class="h-12 w-auto object-contain">
      <h1 class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">产品系列展示</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row flex-wrap gap-2 text-gray-700 text-sm md:text-base">
      <span class="px-2 py-1 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded font-semibold text-red-600">⚠️ 保密声明：内部信息，仅供参考</span>
      <span class="px-2 py-1 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded text-green-700">📊 数据来源：采购管理部</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 悬浮导航按钮 -->
  <button id="toggleBtn" class="p-2 rounded-full shadow text-white hover:bg-red-600">☰</button>

  <div class="flex flex-col min-h-screen">
    <div class="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
      <!-- 左侧导航 -->
      <div id="sidebar" class="w-64 bg-white shadow-lg p-4 overflow-y-auto hidden fixed md:relative md:block">
        <div id="series-list" class="flex flex-col gap-2"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- 右侧产品区 -->
      <div class="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto md:ml-64 flex justify-center">
        <div id="products" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 justify-items-center w-full max-w-7xl"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 底部版权 -->
    <footer class="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mt-8 mb-4">
      © 2025 德令哈采购管理部提供技术和数据支持
    </footer>
  </div>

  <!-- 图片放大遮罩 -->
  <div id="lightbox" class="flex" onclick="this.style.display='none'">
    <img id="lightbox-img" src="" alt="大图">
  </div>

  <script>
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggleBtn');
    const seriesList = document.getElementById('series-list');
    const productsDiv = document.getElementById('products');
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('lightbox');
    const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');

    toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      sidebar.classList.toggle('hidden');
      sidebar.classList.toggle('show');
    });
    sidebar.classList.add('hidden');

    fetch('data.json')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        const seriesSet = new Set(data.map(item => item.系列));
        const seriesNames = Array.from(seriesSet);
        let currentSeries = seriesNames[0];

        seriesNames.forEach(series => {
          const btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.textContent = series;
          btn.className = 'px-4 py-2 bg-red-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-red-600 text-left';
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            currentSeries = series;
            renderProducts(series);
            if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
              sidebar.classList.remove('show');
              sidebar.classList.add('hidden');
            }
          });
          seriesList.appendChild(btn);
        });

        function renderProducts(series) {
          productsDiv.innerHTML = '';
          const filtered = data.filter(item => item.系列 === series);
          filtered.forEach(product => {
            const imgSrc = `/assets/product/${product.图片}`;
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'product-card bg-white rounded-xl shadow p-4 fade-in flex flex-col items-center transition cursor-pointer w-full sm:max-w-sm md:max-w-md lg:max-w-md max-h-card';
            card.innerHTML = `
              <img src="${imgSrc}" alt="${product.产品名称}" class="w-full h-40 object-cover mb-3 rounded-lg">
              <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between w-full text-center">
                <h3 class="font-semibold text-lg truncate">${product.产品名称}</h3>
                <p class="text-gray-600 text-sm truncate">${product.规格}</p>
                <p class="text-red-600 font-semibold mt-1">￥${product.价格}</p>
                ${product.说明 && product.说明 !== "null" ? `<p class="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">${product.说明}</p>` : ''}
              </div>
            `;
            const img = card.querySelector('img');
            img.addEventListener('click', e => {
              lightboxImg.src = img.src;
              lightbox.style.display = 'flex';
              e.stopPropagation();
            });
            productsDiv.appendChild(card);
          });
        }

        renderProducts(currentSeries);
      })
      .catch(err => console.error('读取 data.json 出错:', err));
  </script>
</body>
</html>

✅改造特点：

  1. 顶部卡片式 （Logo + 标题 + 保密声明）

  2. 左侧悬浮导航 可收起/滑出

  3. 产品卡片保持原有 hover 效果

  4. 光箱效果保留

  5. 使用 TailwindCSS + fade-in 动画

                <p class="text-gray-600 text-sm truncate">${product.规格}</p>
                <p class="text-red-600 font-semibold mt-1">￥${product.价格}</p>
                ${product.说明 && product.说明 !== "null" ? `<p class="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">${product.说明}</p>` : ''}
              </div>
            `;
            const img = card.querySelector('img');
            img.addEventListener('click', e => {
              lightboxImg.src = img.src;
              lightbox.style.display = 'flex';
              e.stopPropagation();
            });
            productsDiv.appendChild(card);
          });
        }

        // 默认渲染第一个系列
        topTitle.textContent = currentSeries;
        renderProducts(currentSeries);
      })
      .catch(err => console.error('读取 data.json 出错:', err));
  </script>
</body>
</html>

完整代码如下：

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>产品系列展示</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <style>
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-in; }
    #sidebar { transition: transform 0.3s; z-index:50; }
    #sidebar.hidden { transform: translateX(-100%); }
    #sidebar.show { transform: translateX(0); }
    #toggleBtn { position: fixed; top: 1rem; left: 1rem; z-index:60; background-color:#ef4444; }
    #toggleBtn:hover { background-color:#dc2626; }
    .product-card { transition: all 0.3s; }
    .product-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 15px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
    #lightbox { display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.8); justify-content:center; align-items:center; z-index:100; }
    #lightbox img { max-width:90%; max-height:90%; border-radius:12px; }
    .max-h-card { max-height:420px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-50 font-sans">

  <!-- 顶部卡片 -->
  <div id="topCard" class="max-w-7xl mx-auto bg-white shadow-lg rounded-xl p-6 mb-6 fade-in flex flex-col items-center">
    <img src="/assets/img/trtlogo.png" alt="LOGO" class="h-12 w-auto object-contain mb-2">
    <h1 id="topTitle" class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 text-center">产品系列展示</h1>
  </div>

  <!-- 悬浮导航按钮 -->
  <button id="toggleBtn" class="p-2 rounded-full shadow text-white hover:bg-red-600">☰</button>

  <div class="flex flex-col min-h-screen">
    <div class="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
      <!-- 左侧导航 -->
      <div id="sidebar" class="w-64 bg-white shadow-lg p-4 overflow-y-auto hidden fixed md:relative md:block">
        <div id="series-list" class="flex flex-col gap-3"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- 右侧产品区 -->
      <div class="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto md:ml-64 flex justify-center">
        <div id="products" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 justify-items-center w-full max-w-7xl"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 底部版权 -->
    <footer class="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mt-8 mb-4">
      © 2025 德令哈采购管理部提供技术和数据支持
    </footer>
  </div>

  <!-- 图片放大遮罩 -->
  <div id="lightbox" class="flex" onclick="this.style.display='none'">
    <img id="lightbox-img" src="" alt="大图">
  </div>

  <script>
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggleBtn');
    const seriesList = document.getElementById('series-list');
    const productsDiv = document.getElementById('products');
    const topTitle = document.getElementById('topTitle');
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('lightbox');
    const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');

    toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      sidebar.classList.toggle('hidden');
      sidebar.classList.toggle('show');
    });
    sidebar.classList.add('hidden');

    fetch('data.json')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        const seriesSet = new Set(data.map(item => item.系列));
        const seriesNames = Array.from(seriesSet);
        let currentSeries = seriesNames[0];

        // 左侧系列导航按钮
        seriesNames.forEach(series => {
          const btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.textContent = series;
          btn.className = 'px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-red-400 to-red-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-md hover:from-red-500 hover:to-red-700 transform hover:scale-105 transition';
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            currentSeries = series;
            topTitle.textContent = series; // 动态更新顶部标题
            renderProducts(series);
            if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
              sidebar.classList.remove('show');
              sidebar.classList.add('hidden');
            }
          });
          seriesList.appendChild(btn);
        });

        function renderProducts(series) {
          productsDiv.innerHTML = '';
          const filtered = data.filter(item => item.系列 === series);
          filtered.forEach(product => {
            const imgSrc = `/assets/product/${product.图片}`;
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'product-card bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md p-4 fade-in flex flex-col items-center transition cursor-pointer w-full sm:max-w-sm md:max-w-md lg:max-w-md max-h-card';
            card.innerHTML = `
              <div class="overflow-hidden rounded-lg w-full h-48 mb-3">
                <img src="${imgSrc}" alt="${product.产品名称}" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 transform hover:scale-105">
              </div>
              <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between w-full text-center">
                <h3 class="font-semibold text-lg truncate">${product.产品名称}</h3>
                <p class="text-gray-600 text-sm truncate">${product.规格}</p>
                <p class="text-red-600 font-semibold mt-1">￥${product.价格}</p>
                ${product.说明 && product.说明 !== "null" ? `<p class="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">${product.说明}</p>` : ''}
              </div>
            `;
            const img = card.querySelector('img');
            img.addEventListener('click', e => {
              lightboxImg.src = img.src;
              lightbox.style.display = 'flex';
              e.stopPropagation();
            });
            productsDiv.appendChild(card);
          });
        }

        // 默认渲染第一个系列
        topTitle.textContent = currentSeries;
        renderProducts(currentSeries);
      })
      .catch(err => console.error('读取 data.json 出错:', err));
  </script>
</body>
</html>

改动总结：

  1. 顶部标题居中 ： flex flex-col items-center + text-center

  2. 左侧系列按钮美化 ：圆角、渐变背景、悬浮放大

  3. 保持产品卡片、光箱和响应式布局风格

    <!-- 左侧导航 -->
    <div id="sidebar" class="w-64 bg-white shadow-lg p-4 overflow-y-auto hidden md:block fixed md:relative md:top-0 md:left-0">
      <div id="series-list" class="flex flex-col gap-3"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- 右侧产品区 -->
    <main class="flex-1 p-6 md:ml-64 flex justify-center">
      <div id="products" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 justify-items-center w-full max-w-7xl"></div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- 底部版权 -->
  <footer class="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mt-8 mb-4">
    © 2025 德令哈采购管理部提供技术和数据支持
  </footer>

  <!-- 图片放大遮罩 -->
  <div id="lightbox" class="flex" onclick="this.style.display='none'">
    <img id="lightbox-img" src="" alt="大图">
  </div>

  <script>
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggleBtn');
    const seriesList = document.getElementById('series-list');
    const productsDiv = document.getElementById('products');
    const topTitle = document.getElementById('topTitle');
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('lightbox');
    const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');

    toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      sidebar.classList.toggle('hidden');
      sidebar.classList.toggle('show');
    });

    sidebar.classList.add('hidden'); // 默认隐藏

    fetch('data.json')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        const seriesSet = new Set(data.map(item => item.系列));
        const seriesNames = Array.from(seriesSet);
        let currentSeries = seriesNames[0];

        // 左侧系列导航按钮
        seriesNames.forEach(series => {
          const btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.textContent = series;
          btn.className = 'px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-red-400 to-red-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-md hover:from-red-500 hover:to-red-700 transform hover:scale-105 transition';
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            currentSeries = series;
            topTitle.textContent = series; // 动态更新标题
            renderProducts(series);
            if(window.innerWidth<768){
              sidebar.classList.add('hidden');
              sidebar.classList.remove('show');
            }
          });
          seriesList.appendChild(btn);
        });

        function renderProducts(series){
          productsDiv.innerHTML = '';
          const filtered = data.filter(item => item.系列 === series);
          filtered.forEach(product => {
            const imgSrc = `/assets/product/${product.图片}`;
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'product-card bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md p-4 fade-in flex flex-col items-center transition cursor-pointer w-full sm:max-w-sm md:max-w-md lg:max-w-md max-h-card';
            card.innerHTML = `
              <div class="overflow-hidden rounded-lg w-full h-48 mb-3">
                <img src="${imgSrc}" alt="${product.产品名称}" class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 transform hover:scale-105">
              </div>
              <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between w-full text-center">
                <h3 class="font-semibold text-lg truncate">${product.产品名称}</h3>
                <p class="text-gray-600 text-sm truncate">${product.规格}</p>
                <p class="text-red-600 font-semibold mt-1">￥${product.价格}</p>
                ${product.说明 && product.说明!=="null"?`<p class="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">${product.说明}</p>`:''}
              </div>
            `;
            const img = card.querySelector('img');
            img.addEventListener('click', e=>{
              lightboxImg.src=img.src;
              lightbox.style.display='flex';
              e.stopPropagation();
            });
            productsDiv.appendChild(card);
          });
        }

        topTitle.textContent = currentSeries;
        renderProducts(currentSeries);
      })
      .catch(err=>console.error('读取 data.json 出错:', err));
  </script>
</body>
</html>
✅ 改动说明：
  1. 标题栏 ：

-flex justify-between→ LOGO+标题靠左，按钮靠右 - 不随滚动悬浮 - LOGO 高度h-16，标题稍小

  1. 导航按钮 ：
  • 放在标题栏右侧 - 点击显示/隐藏左侧导航

  1. 产品卡片 保持原有样式，悬浮放大效果不动

  2. 响应式 ：小屏幕点击按钮即可滑出导航

如果你需要，我可以把顶部标题栏背景加渐变 + 阴影，让视觉更有质感，同时保持 LOGO 左、按钮右。

<!DOCTYPE html>

<body class="bg-gray-50 font-sans">

  <!-- 顶部标题栏 -->

Q24 · 标题栏居中（第 24 轮对话）

提问： 标题栏居中

看起来我们之前并没有创建一个 canvas 文档，所以我没法直接 “替你改代码”。别担心，我们还是能解决 😊

你现在的需求是：标题栏居中。

如果你已经有类似标题的代码，比如：

<div class="bg-white shadow p-4 mb-4">
  <h1 class="text-xl font-bold">产品系列展示</h1>
</div>

请把h1标签加上text-centerTailwind 类：

<div class="bg-white shadow p-4 mb-4">
  <h1 class="text-xl font-bold text-center">产品系列展示</h1>
</div>

如果标题栏是 flex 布局，你也可以给外层加：

<div class="bg-white shadow p-4 mb-4 flex justify-center">
✅ 小结

你可以通过以下方式让标题居中：

  • 在 h1 加 text-center

  • 或在容器加 flex justify-center

如果你愿意，我可以帮你直接改文件 ✅ 请把当前的顶部标题栏那段 HTML 贴出来，或者说“把这个页面放入 canvas”我来帮你改。
